newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower in thin volume.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a quiet session lower on followthrough selling from Wednesday's sharp break, pit sources said.
"It was a low volume break, but we saw some trade scale-down buying along the way," a trader said. "The market is just nervous at these high levels."
USDA's weekly export sales figure of 49,200 tonnes was more than 10 times the prior week's tally. Costa Rica was the primary buyer.
"Export sales were excellent, as expected, and it was almost all long grain," one floor trader said.
Slow farmer sales underpinned new crop months.
Rice ended 13 to four cents per cwt lower with July down 12-1/2 at $11.53-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 250 lots, compared with Wednesday's actual volume of 447 lots.
